title: Draft verdict
description: The Game Director's grade of one card draft against rubrics/draft-game.md. approved carries fits_pillars alone. revise sends the draft back to the Game Designer for another round with the reason codes and the note. flagged withdraws the draft at once; flag it for not_all_ages, breaks_kernel_or_art_policy or duplicate_card. Every code: fits_pillars (meets every rubric line), off_pillar (breaks a Seed 1 pillar), not_all_ages (misses the all-ages rating), not_one_small_change (more than one small change), summary_not_backed (the summary promises more than its check lines prove), estimate_implausible (the estimate does not fit the five-times rule or the change), unclear_text (a player or builder would misread it), duplicate_card (an open card already does this), breaks_kernel_or_art_policy (touches the kernel or needs art other than procedural or vector).

note.description: For the Game Designer's next round: what to change. Never shown to the public.
